title: Emergency oral Schedule II prescription requirements
rule_summary: In a defined emergency, a pharmacist may dispense an oral Schedule II prescription only in the quantity necessary for the emergency period after immediate communication with and reasonable identification of the prescriber.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply emergency schedule ii requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Emergency oral Schedule II prescription requirements

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing emergency schedule ii with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
